tools.name: shoot_plan_capabilities
tools.description: Return truthful Shoot Plan scope, availability, privacy and commercial state.

tools.name: shoot_plan_example
tools.description: Return a synthetic example plan generated by the real planner, with its provenance.

tools.name: shoot_plan_quote
tools.description: Calculate a deterministic public quote from non-private project metadata. Do not send a script or brief.

tools.name: shoot_plan_create
tools.description: Create a plan for an authenticated organisation after authoritative payment confirmation.

tools.name: shoot_plan_list
tools.description: List the authenticated organisation's Shoot Plans, most recently changed first, without returning private intake or full plan content. Archived plans are left out unless includeArchived is true. Each plan's taskId is the ID every other plan tool takes. Structured result: {plans:[...]}.

tools.name: shoot_plan_status
tools.description: Return a plan's status, version, whether its included revision is used, its customer-facing order reference, and progress (essential shots ticked, next shot, when the last tick was made). Read-only. Use the full taskId from shoot_plan_list (not planId). A unique eight-character task prefix or orderR
